fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A hamstringing strike that deals 16 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Stride
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and strikes it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Shortened Road
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +6% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Second Mile
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
